property_summary: After a player calls settle once, their guess slot is cleared, so any subsequent settle call must revert regardless of inputs; the mutant keeps the slot set, letting settle succeed (and potentially pay out) again.
change_summary: Delete the statement `guesses[msg.sender].block = 0;` so a user can settle repeatedly and, with a matching guess, withdraw the prize multiple times.
